import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

STUDENT = Student("7", "Rivera", "Ana", "A")

def mark(day, status="absent", student_id="7"):
    return Mark(student_id, date(2026, 9, day), status)

class BuildNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absences_in_order(self):
        marks = [mark(9), mark(2), mark(5, "present")]
        text = build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Rivera missed 2 days.", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-09", text)

    def test_single_day(self):
        text = build_notice(STUDENT, [mark(3)])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day.", text)

    def test_excused_not_counted(self):
        marks = [mark(3), mark(4, "excused")]
        text = build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertNotIn("2026-09-04", text)

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark(3), mark(4, student_id="8")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, [mark(3, "present")])

    def test_no_marks(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, [])
